name: JobSearchShortlist_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on job searching.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on finding the right job, including users preferences and exploring multiple opportunities.

variations.context: Working through a job-application shortlist together

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners, one job-hunting and one helping
setting.background: A shortlist of roles built up over the week, none a perfect fit
setting.conversation_style: Practical and honest, with some encouragement

scenario_template.topic: Reviewing which roles are worth applying for
scenario_template.note: They go through a shortlist built up over the week No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.note: The gap between the job description and the CV is the sticking point No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to find a suitable job but has limited experience with job searching and can become overwhelmed when faced with many listings, application requirements, unfamiliar roles, or competing priorities.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help manage the job search, but tends to overthink opportunities, compare positions extensively, double-check application materials, and seek confirmation before applying.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
